info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

GLLine.title: GL Line
GLLine.description: A debit-or-credit line within a GLTransaction, encoding the polarity in the side enum per REQ-GL-003. Extended with eliminationFlag to support GR consolidation per REQ-GRC-003.

side.description: Debit or credit polarity; amount is always non-negative.

amount.description: Non-negative posting amount in the transaction's currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must equal the parent GLTransaction.currency (T1 single-currency invariant).

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod. Auto-resolved by the lifecycle engine on the GLTransaction.post transition.

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger discriminator; T2 owns the actual sub-ledger registers.

subLedgerRef.description: FK into the sub-ledger when subLedgerType is not none.

costCenter.description: Cost-center or department code for allocation reporting.

eliminationFlag.description: When true, excludes this line from the consolidated trial-balance and financial-statement aggregations. Used to eliminate inter-GR transactions from consolidated views per REQ-GRC-003.

consolidatedTrialBalance.description: Trial-balance rollup that excludes inter-GR lines flagged for elimination. Produces debit and credit totals per accountNumber for the GR own jaarrekening per REQ-GRC-003.

GRDeelnemer.title: GR Deelnemer
GRDeelnemer.description: A deelnemer (participating municipality, province, or waterboard) of a gemeenschappelijke regeling (GR). Holds the quotum-aandeel and an optional cross-administration FK for doorbelasting materialisation per REQ-GRC-001.

administrationId.description: Optional FK to the deelnemer's own shillinq administration. When set, a balanced GLTransaction is materialised in that administration on GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.

aandeel.description: Quotum-aandeel (participation share) of this deelnemer in the GR. Must be 0 ≤ x ≤ 1. The sum across all actief deelnemers SHOULD equal 1.0.

actief.description: Whether this deelnemer currently participates in the GR. Inactive deelnemers are excluded from the aandeel-sum invariant check.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of the deelnemer record.

active.label: Active
active.description: Deelnemer participates in the GR and is included in aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Deelnemer no longer participates. Historical records remain queryable; excluded from aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archive.label: Archive deelnemer
archive.description: Remove from active participation without deleting historical boekingen.

onGrPeriodClose.description: When the GR period closes, materialise a balanced GLTransaction in each deelnemer's administration where administrationId is set. Idempotency key: (grAdministrationId, deelnemerId, periodId) prevents re-posting on re-run of GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.
onGrPeriodClose.condition: administrationId IS NOT NULL AND lifecycleState = 'active'

aandeelSumCheck.description: Computes the sum of aandeel across all actief deelnemers. Surfaces a non-blocking warning in the Consolidated view when the result differs from 1.0 per REQ-GRC-004 and design Risk 2.

GRVerdeelsleutel.title: GR Verdeelsleutel
GRVerdeelsleutel.description: An apportionment rule linking a cost-cluster (set of accountNumbers) to a per-deelnemer split method. Multiple verdeelsleutels MAY apply to the same cost cluster, sequenced by lineNumber per REQ-GRC-002.

sleutelNaam.description: Human-readable name of this apportionment rule.

costClusterAccountNumbers.description: Array of Account.accountNumber strings identifying the cost cluster this verdeelsleutel applies to.

verdelingsType.description: Apportionment method. vast-percentage uses fixed per-deelnemer percentages in parameters; inwoner-aantal weights by population count; gewogen-oppervlak by weighted surface area; custom-formula accepts free-form parameters JSON.

parameters.description: Per-deelnemer split parameters validated against verdelingsType. For vast-percentage: object keyed by GRDeelnemer.id with values summing to 1.0. For custom-formula: arbitrary JSON.

lineNumber.description: Sequence number controlling the order in which multiple verdeelsleutels for the same cost cluster are applied.

doorbelastingPerDeelnemer.description: Per-deelnemer doorbelasting aggregation: applies this verdeelsleutel to GLLines whose accountNumber is in costClusterAccountNumbers (excluding eliminated lines). Produces doorbelasting bedrag per deelnemer per cost cluster per REQ-GRC-004.

join.condition: GLLine.accountNumber IN costClusterAccountNumbers AND GLLine.eliminationFlag = false

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

Iv3Export.title: IV3 Export
Iv3Export.description: Quarterly IV3 (Informatie voor Derden) export to CBS for Dutch decentralised government administrations. Lifecycle covers generation, validation, submission, and CBS acceptance/rejection.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (gemeente/provincie/waterschap) that this export belongs to.

reportingYear.description: Calendar year of the IV3 reporting period (e.g. 2026).

iv3Version.description: CBS IV3-bestand specification version used for this export (e.g. '2026.1').

buckets.description: Aggregated GL values keyed by IV3 bucket code (sum of debit minus credit per bucket for closed-period postings). Derived via x-openregister-aggregations — do not set directly.

xmlAttachmentUri.description: Docudesk URI of the generated CBS IV3 XML file.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the IV3 export.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was generated.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was submitted to CBS.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when CBS accepted the export.

cbsMessageId.description: CBS-side message identifier returned on submission.

correctionOf.description: FK to a prior Iv3Export.id that this export supersedes (correction flow).

generated.label: Generated
generated.description: Export created and XML artifact generated. Awaiting operator validation.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: XML validated against the CBS IV3 schema. Ready for operator submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Submitted to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3. Awaiting CBS acknowledgement.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.description: CBS accepted the export. Terminal state unless a correction is filed.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: CBS rejected the export. Operator must correct and re-validate.

corrected.label: Corrected
corrected.description: A correction export (with correctionOf set) supersedes this one.

retention.description: IV3 verantwoording-naar-derden records retained 10 years per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

validate.label: Validate XML
validate.description: Operator validates the generated XML against the CBS IV3 schema.

submit.label: Submit to CBS
submit.description: Operator submits the validated export to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3.

accept.label: CBS Accepted
accept.description: CBS accepted the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

reject.label: CBS Rejected
reject.description: CBS rejected the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

revalidate.label: Re-validate after fix
revalidate.description: Operator re-validates after correcting the rejection reason.

correct.label: File correction
correct.description: Operator files a corrected export (sets correctionOf on the new Iv3Export).

buckets.description: Sum of (debit - credit) per IV3 bucket code over closed-period GLLine rows for this export's administrationId + quarter. Joins GLLine → Account → BbvAccountMapping.iv3Bucket (T3 bbv-compliance). Filters to periodIds closed per T2 period-close boundaries.

quarterly-cbs-submission.name: IV3 quarterly CBS submission
quarterly-cbs-submission.description: Generates and submits IV3 exports for all closed gemeente/provincie/waterschap administrations on a quarterly schedule.

Subsidie.title: Subsidie
Subsidie.description: Grant/subsidy register covering the full ASV-model lifecycle (aanvraag → verleend → vastgesteld → uitbetaald → teruggevorderd → afgehandeld) for both outgoing and incoming grants. Overlaid by the R&D regelingen via the subsidieRegeling enum per bookkeeping-r-d-subsidies-mkb.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this subsidie record.

direction.description: outgoing = administration grants to beneficiary; incoming = administration receives from granting body.

subsidieNumber.description: Unique subsidie reference per administration and tax year.

counterpartyName.description: Beneficiary name (outgoing) or granting body name (incoming).

counterpartyId.description: Optional FK to a contact record if the counterparty is registered.

regelingNaam.description: Name of the underlying subsidie regeling.

regelingArtikel.description: Specific article reference within the regeling.

subsidieRegeling.description: R&D regeling discriminator per REQ-RDS-001. When set to a non-other value, the regeling-specific kostencategorieën constraint (REQ-RDS-002) applies on related Kostenpost records. The schema:Grant type is further materialised as schema:ResearchProject when this field is set to a non-other value.

verleendBedrag.description: Granted amount — set on the verleen transition.

vastgesteldBedrag.description: Settled amount — set on the vaststel transition.

uitbetaaldBedrag.description: Paid amount — set on the uitbetaal transition.

teruggevorderdBedrag.description: Reclaimed amount — set on the terugvorder transition.

beschikkingUri.description: Docudesk URI of the verleningsbeschikking PDF.

vaststellingUri.description: Docudesk URI of the vaststellingsbeschikking PDF.

repaymentPlanId.description: FK to a RepaymentInstallment parent record if a settlement plan applies.

uitbetaald.label: Uitbetaald
uitbetaald.description: Subsidie paid; GL journal entry posted.

teruggevorderd.label: Teruggevorderd
teruggevorderd.description: Repayment demanded; repayment plan may apply.

afgehandeld.label: Afgehandeld
afgehandeld.description: Dossier closed; record retained per selectielijst.

retention.description: Subsidie records retained 10 years after vaststelling per Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020 + Awb 4:52.

verleen.label: Verleen
verleen.description: Grant the subsidie. Requires dual-control approval (subsidie-coordinator + manager), verleendBedrag MUST be set, beschikkingUri SHOULD be set.

wijs-af.label: Wijs af
wijs-af.description: Reject the aanvraag. Reason MUST be set.

vaststel.label: Vaststel
vaststel.description: Settle the subsidie. prestatieverantwoording and vastgesteldBedrag MUST be set; vaststellingUri SHOULD be set.

uitbetaal.label: Uitbetaal
uitbetaal.description: Pay the subsidie. uitbetaaldBedrag MUST equal vastgesteldBedrag. Creates a pending T1 JournalEntry.

terugvorder.label: Terugvordering
terugvorder.description: Reclaim grant funds. teruggevorderdBedrag and reason MUST be set. Requires dual-control approval.

sluit-uitbetaald.label: Sluit dossier
sluit-uitbetaald.description: Close the dossier after retention obligations are met.

sluit-teruggevorderd.label: Sluit dossier (terugvordering)
sluit-teruggevorderd.description: Close the dossier after the repayment plan is fully settled (repaymentBalance MUST equal 0).

voortgangsrapportage-mit.description: MIT voortgangsrapportage: groups Kostenpost records by (kostencategorie, periodId) for MIT subsidies, producing cumulative and periodic totals per MIT kostencategorie per REQ-RDS-003.

voortgangsrapportage-sbir.description: SBIR voortgangsrapportage: groups Kostenpost records by (kostencategorie, periodId) for SBIR subsidies per REQ-RDS-003.

voortgangsrapportage-eu-horizon.description: EU Horizon Periodic Report: groups Kostenpost records by (kostencategorie, periodId) for EU Horizon subsidies, following the Horizon canonical layout with cumulative + periodic totals per Horizon category per REQ-RDS-003.

voortgangsrapportage-efro.description: EFRO progress dossier: groups Kostenpost records by (kostencategorie, periodId) for EFRO subsidies per REQ-RDS-003.

horizon-indirect-25pct-warning.description: EU Horizon indirect-25% budget monitoring: warns when indirect-25% costs reach ≥90% of the 25%-of-direct-costs sub-maximum per REQ-RDS-005.

warnings.message: indirect-25% limit of {directCosts * 0.25} approaching; current usage {round(formula * 100)}%

mit-budget-monitoring.description: MIT per-kostencategorie budget monitoring: warns when any MIT kostencategorie reaches ≥90% of its sub-maximum per REQ-RDS-005.

warnings.message: MIT personnel costs at {round(formula * 100)}% of verleend budget

efro-indirect-flat-rate-warning.description: EFRO indirect flat-rate monitoring: warns when indirect-flat-rate costs reach ≥90% of the allowed flat-rate ceiling per REQ-RDS-005.

warnings.message: EFRO indirect flat-rate limit approaching; current usage {round(formula * 100)}%

Kostenpost.title: Kostenpost
Kostenpost.description: An individual cost item within a subsidie's kostendossier. The allowed kostencategorie values are constrained per subsidieRegeling via JSON Schema if/then rules per REQ-RDS-002.

subsidieRegeling.description: Denormalized regeling discriminator from the parent Subsidie for schema-level kostencategorie validation per REQ-RDS-002.

kostencategorie.description: Cost category for this kostenpost; allowed values depend on subsidieRegeling per REQ-RDS-002.

periodId.description: Reporting period identifier (e.g. 2026-Q1) for voortgangsrapportage grouping per REQ-RDS-003.

amount.description: Kostenpost amount in the subsidie's currency.

description.description: Free-text description of the cost item.

attachmentUris.description: Docudesk or external URIs of supporting documents (timesheets, invoices, receipts). EU Horizon audit-pack references personnel kostenpost URIs to S&O-uren-staten per REQ-RDS-004.

subsidie.description: Parent subsidie for this cost item.

iv3-xml-transformation.name: IV3 XML Transformation
iv3-xml-transformation.description: Maps an Iv3Export record (with aggregated buckets) to the CBS IV3-bestand XML structure. ADR-031 declarative path — preferred over a PHP renderer. If OR's mapping engine cannot express CBS mixed-content XML nodes, the Iv3XmlRenderer::render() exception path (documented in openspec/changes/add-shillinq-iv3-reporting/design.md §D3) applies.
